verses.en: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.sm: Suria Ua mavae lea mea, ona fafasi ai lea e Tavita ia Filisitia, ma faatoilalo ia te i latou, ma ua faoa Kata ma ona faoa aai nai Filisitia.

verses.en: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David's servants, and brought gifts.
verses.sm: Ua ia fasia foi Moapi; ona avea lea o Moapi ma pologa ia Tavita, ua latou au mai ai taulaga.

verses.en: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.sm: Ua fasia foi e Tavita 0 Atatesa le tupu o Sopa e oo atu Amato, ina ua alu atu o ia e faatumau lana pule i le vaitafe o Eufirate.

verses.en: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.sm: Ua maua e Tavita nai ia te ia, O kariota e tasi le afe, ma e tietie i solofanua e fitu o afe, ma “au e savavali o tagata e lua sefulu o afe; ua vaevae e Tavita o ua o vae o solofanua i kariota uma, a ua faasao ai māna o kariota e selau.

verses.en: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.sm: Ua o mai tagata o Suria mai Tamaseko e fesoasoani ia Atatesa le tupu o Sopa, ona fāsia lea e Tavita o Suria e lua sefulu o afe ma afe e lua o tagata.

verses.en: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David's servants, and brought gifts. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.sm: Ua tuu e Tavita leoleoga i Suria Tamaseko; ua avea Suria ma pologa ia Tavita, ua latou au mai ai taulaga. Ua faasaoina Tavita e le ALII i mea uma na ia alu i ai.

verses.en: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.sm: Ua ave e Tavita o talita auro na i ai i auauna a Atatesa, ua au mai ai i Jerusalema.

verses.en: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.sm: Ua avea foi e Tavita o ‘apa memea e tele lava mai Tipeata ma Kuna, o aai o Atatesa, na fai ai e Solomona o le vai ‘apa memea, ma pou, ma ipu ‘apa memea.

verses.en: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.sm: Ua logona e Tou le tupu o Amato ua fasia e Tavita ‘au uma a Atatesa le tupu o Sopa,

verses.en: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to enquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.sm: ona awna mai ai lea o lona atalii o Aturamo i le tupu o Tavita, e alofa ia te ia, ma faafetai ia te ia, ina ua tau o ia ma Atatesa ma fasi ia te ia; aua sa va tau Atatesa ma Tou; ua au mai foi e ia o ipu eseese uma lava o auro, ma ario, ma “apa memea.

verses.en: Them also king David dedicated unto the LORD, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.sm: Ua faasaina foi e le 1upu o Tavita o ia mea i le ALI, atoa ma le ario ma le auro na aumaia e ia mai nuu ese uma nei, o Etoma, ma Moapi, ma le fanauga a Amoni, ma Filisitia, ma Amaleka.

verses.en: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.sm: Ua fasia foi e Apisai le tama a Seruia o Etoma e sefulu afe ma afe e valu i le vanu masimá.

verses.en: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David's servants. Thus the LORD preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.sm: Ona tuu lea e ia o leoleoga i Etoma; ma ua avea Etoma uma ma pologa a Tavita. Ua faasaoina Tavita e le ALII i mea uma na ia alu i ai.

verses.en: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
verses.sm: Ua faia Tavita ma tupu i Isaraelu uma, ua ia faia foi le faamasinoga ma le tonu i lona nuu uma lava.

verses.en: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.sm: O Ioapo le tama a Seruia na pule o ia i ‘au; o losefatu le atalii o Ailuta o le fatua‘iupu o ia;

verses.en: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.sm: o Satoka le atalii o Akitopo, ma Aimeleka le atalii o Aviata, o faitaulaga i laua; ma Savesa o le tusiupu ia;

verses.en: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.sm: O Penaia le atalii o loiata na pule i le au Kereti ma le au Peleti; o atalii foi o Tavita o alii sili i latou e vava-lalata ma le tupu.
